# SpaceNinjaServer v0.1.0

This is the first official release of the SpaceNinjaServer fork maintained by Specia1z. It focuses on compatibility with the Warframe 42.0.11 client family while preserving upstream OpenWF attribution and licensing. The release provides independent deployment, live world-state synchronization, and private-server global progress tracking.

## Highlights

- Synchronizes and adapts alerts, Goals, fissures, sorties, Void Storms, syndicate missions, Nightwave, calendar seasons, Descents, vendor rotations, and other supported world-state data.
- Maintains Goal and invasion global progress, completion state, restart recovery, and delayed cleanup independently in MongoDB without allowing official dynamic progress to overwrite private-server state.
- Includes account initialization, mission progression, starter rewards, configurable mission Platinum rewards, mastery cooldowns, and WebUI administration.
- Provides Windows, Linux, and macOS archives with Node.js 24.8.0 included. A separate Node.js installation is not required.
- Publishes `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64` Docker images with a complete Compose configuration containing MongoDB, OpenWF IRC, and OpenWF Hub.

## Downloads

| Platform | Architecture | File |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows | x64 | `SpaceNinjaServer-v0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux | x64 | `SpaceNinjaServer-v0.1.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Linux | ARM64 | `SpaceNinjaServer-v0.1.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Intel x64 | `SpaceNinjaServer-v0.1.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | Apple Silicon ARM64 | `SpaceNinjaServer-v0.1.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |

Use `SHA256SUMS.txt` to verify downloaded files. After extracting an archive, run `start.cmd` on Windows or `./start.sh` on Linux and macOS. The launcher creates `config.json` from `config-vanilla.json` on first use. Review the address, ports, administrator names, and certificate settings before exposing the server to a network.

Unprivileged Linux users normally cannot bind to TCP ports 80 and 443. Use higher ports in `config.json` with a reverse proxy for production deployments. On macOS, downloaded unsigned Node.js binaries may need to be allowed under Privacy & Security before their first launch.

## Docker

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/specia1z/spaceninjaserver:latest
docker compose up -d
```

The versioned image for this release is `ghcr.io/specia1z/spaceninjaserver:v0.1.0`. An immutable commit-SHA tag is also available. The Compose configuration continues to use the upstream OpenWF IRC and Hub images.
